rules: GET requests never create a prediction record
Scoring uses the configured recorded meal baseline, never the newest follow-up timestamp
Each explicit refresh saves a new attempt, including unavailable or insufficient data
Model inputs and returned prediction are immutable; reviews append separate records
Missing or conflicting follow-up cannot establish a negative sampled outcome
A valid positive sample may establish an observed event with incomplete coverage
No comparison for unavailable scores, retrospective results or changed inputs
Eight 15-minute samples do not establish continuous coverage
Review identity is not authenticated; public inputs remain synthetic-only
